text:
zoe: Quick sync — we need a lean GA checklist for the upcoming launch focused on two non-negotiables: customer data residency controls + tiered SLOs by customer segment. Who can own what?

liam: I can own SLO definition and validation. proposal: Gold/Tier1: p99 < 200ms, 99.95% uptime; Silver/Tier2: p99 < 400ms, 99.9% uptime; Bronze: best-effort with documented fallbacks. Thoughts?

anjali: I'll take docs + onboarding flows. Need exact language for playbook + runbooks (what to tell customers when we throttle or failover). Will add an FAQ for data residency options (hosted / dedicated / private).

devin: I'll own infra gating (private/VPC + KMS). For data residency we need two blockers cleared: 1) per-tenant region pinning in control plane, 2) audit logs exported to customer KMS — both need QA in staging. ETA for tests: 3 business days.

sam: Pricing needs to reflect tiered SLOs — propose a 20% premium for Gold SLA and a 8% premium for Silver; Bronze no premium. Also need clear overage/backstop terms: if customer exceeds committed tokens due to retries, how do we bill?

zoe: Good. We also need monitoring + alerting owners. @liam add thresholds for error budget burn alerts and paged vs non-paged alerts.

liam: Agreed. Suggested alerts: error_budget_burn_rate > 5%/1h -> non-paged slack alert; > 20%/1h -> page oncall. Latency regression: p95 spike > 2x baseline -> non-paged first, escalate if sustained > 30m.

anjali: Docs checklist for GA: API contract, SLA table, how-to-enable data residency, migration guide (hosted -> dedicated), downgrade guidance, billing examples. I'll draft and link to the product examples.

devin: Ops blockers: we need a smoke test that validates per-tenant KV cache pinning and cross-region latency tail behavior. I'll add it to the smoke pipeline.

sam: Commercial asks: enterprise legal will want SLA penalties spelled out (credits only). Also need a one-pager for sales summarizing tiers, limits, and cutover playbook.

zoe: Action items: liam -> finalize SLO numbers + error budget policy (due EOD tomorrow); anjali -> first docs draft + customer-facing FAQ (due 48h); devin -> gating tests in staging + KMS export proof (48h); sam -> publish pricing delta + sales one-pager (72h). Put blockers in here as they appear.

liam: I'll include fallback policies too: automatic model-fallback to smaller quantized variant when burst latency > threshold, and degrade streaming chunk size to reduce p99. Add these to SLO docs.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging smoke: per-tenant-region-pincheck: queued.

anjali: One more ask — we should standardize language around data residency options: "Region-bound (hosted), Dedicated-region, Private-airgapped" with clear guarantees (where logs, keys, and backups live). I'll sketch copy.

devin: Note: for Private/airgapped we can't promise real-time SLA parity until we've validated the customer's network — mark as "SLA contingent on network test" in the runbook.

zoe: Good call. Last governance item: gating for GA requires signoff from Product, Infra, Security, and Sales Ops. Anyone not able to sign within 72h should flag.

sam: I'll coordinate Sales Ops signoff after the one-pager lands.

liam: Quick sample SLA table to put in docs (will refine):
```
Tier | p99 lat | Uptime | Credits
Gold | <200ms | 99.95% | 10% monthly credit for breach
Silver | <400ms | 99.9% | 5% monthly credit
Bronze | best-effort | N/A | none
```

anjali: Love that. I'll add a clear examples section showing how credits are calculated with sample invoices.

zoe: OK — if no objections, we'll treat these as the minimal GA acceptance criteria. I'll run the signoff tracker after the deliverables hit. :thumbsup:

devin: no objections from infra side.

liam: sounds good, will post SLO PR tomorrow morning.

sam: ack, will have pricing sheet by EOD Fri.

anjali: I'll start doc PR now and post link when ready.

zoe: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with any new blockers.
